about: (7c CX) Sites.placeConnector's one-part plan: a rope bridge between two marked points on the lips of a dry ravine 20 wide and 20 deep (x 1028-1047, floor 44, the whole depth of the terrain). `plan`, `claim` and `anchors` are what ConnectorPlace.planOf makes of ConnectorRequest(rope_bridge, cx_from, cx_to) (ApiCXTest holds Java's answer equal to them; the claim is the ends' x/z box plus 16 each side): the kit test plans it, the gate builds the terrain and places the connector through Sites.placeConnector
